question: For each Step D ON DOWN20 arm that fell, which leg group of admitted commands and which period (before or after the tilt) of its command stream is sufficient and/or necessary for a fall, when replayed open loop into the matched body?

sources.archive_count_note: 9 archives (5 ON, 4 distinct OFF); the design text's '10' was a miscount, the archive set is unchanged
sources.code_reused: jo_zone_crossing.Trial (Step D context, OFF_DOWN20 tilt), coxa_offset_yoke sim.step override pattern and schedule() rule (transition n applies source samples[n+1]['commanded_joints']), antennal_gravity_live.body_angles, jo_rollover_timing FALL_DEG; unchanged

context: Step D trial OFF_DOWN20_s (JO withheld; gravity R_y(-20 deg) after stored state 5005), CNS seed s of the source; the CNS runs and is read out only: all 42 commanded coordinates applied at every transition come from the declared archive mix; adhesion must be all zero at every transition (the run errors otherwise)

groups.unadmitted: the other 22 coordinates always come from the OFF archive; whether they differ between ON and OFF archives is reported

conditions.FULL_ON: all 20 admitted from ON, every transition (integrity Y2)
conditions.ONLY_FRONT: FRONT from ON, MIDDLE and HIND from OFF
conditions.ONLY_MIDDLE: MIDDLE from ON, others from OFF
conditions.ONLY_HIND: HIND from ON, others from OFF
conditions.NO_FRONT: FRONT from OFF, MIDDLE and HIND from ON
conditions.NO_MIDDLE: MIDDLE from OFF, others from ON
conditions.NO_HIND: HIND from OFF, others from ON
conditions.PRE_ONLY: all 20 admitted from ON for transitions 0-5004, from OFF for transitions 5005-19999
conditions.POST_ONLY: all 20 admitted from OFF for transitions 0-5004, from ON for transitions 5005-19999

arms.name: <CONDITION>__<SOURCE>
arms.order: per source in the order above, conditions in the order above
arms.duration: 20000 physics / 4000 neural transitions each; fresh process each; run once

measures.fall: tilt (antennal_gravity_live.body_angles[0]) >= 45 deg at any stored state 5006-20000 -> FALLS, else STAYS_UP
measures.also_reported: peak tilt after state 5005; first stored state where qpos differs from the OFF archive and from the ON archive

labels.consistency: within G1 (3 sources) and within FLIP (2 sources) separately: a group label, or a time label's presence/absence, is CONSISTENT if identical for every source of that assignment; otherwise MIXED; no pooling across assignments

integrity.Y1_complete: all 45 arms COMPLETE with 20001 samples and 4000 ticks
integrity.Y2_reproduction: each FULL_ON arm's qpos equals its ON archive's qpos at every stored state exactly
integrity.Y3_yoke_audit: every arm's recorded commanded_joints at state n+1 equals the declared mix row n exactly for n = 0..19999; adhesion recorded all zero
integrity.Y4_gravity: recorded gravity (0,0,-9810) for states 0-5005 and exactly R_y(-20 deg) @ (0,0,-9810) from 5006; no applied body wrench; zero external and generalized applied maxima
integrity.Y5_sources: the Step D report and the 9 archives equal the sha256 values above; each arm records its source and cns_seed

design_expectations.E1_FLIP: FRONT SUFFICIENT_AND_NECESSARY in both FLIP sources and POST_ONLY FALLS in both
design_expectations.E2_G1: PRE_ONLY FALLS in all three G1 sources (group not predicted; HIND a weak guess, not scored)
design_expectations.recording: each HELD or NOT_HELD; evaluated only when INTEGRITY_ACCEPTED

declared_interpretation.group_SUFFICIENT_AND_NECESSARY: that leg group's JO-driven commands carry the fall in this open-loop setting
declared_interpretation.PRE_TILT_SUFFICIENT_only: the tonic pre-tilt JO posture suffices: a less stable posture regime
declared_interpretation.POST_TILT_SUFFICIENT_only: the post-tilt command change suffices: delayed consequence of the tilt response
declared_interpretation.mixed_or_none: the fall needs a combination of groups or periods; reported per source

interpretation_limits: Open loop: mixed command streams never occurred in a closed loop; sufficiency here does not mean the closed-loop brain would produce the same fall.
PRE_ONLY / POST_ONLY switch archives at the tilt, putting a commanded-position step at the gravity step.
Five fallen sources; labels per source, no statistics.
The CNS runs because the session requires it; its output does not reach the body.
Step D limits apply (idealised gravity step, modelled JO transduction).
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: All 45 arms run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
